look_here_first: Start with slender, apparently leafless green stems and a single spikelet at each stem tip; inspect scales, the achene and the swollen style base.
photo_note: One species-specific licensed photo for a first-pass learner. Individual variation, complex taxonomy and exact anatomical traits await deeper visual and taxonomy review.
identification_caution: Close-up of common-spikerush single cylindrical terminal spikelet, Montana. Species-level differentiation in the palustris complex remains a later diagnostic task.
